plugin.name: OertheMap
plugin.author: Mark
plugin.purpose: Live-updating map of Oerthe for Ancient Anguish

muclient.script:
-- =========================================================================== -- OertheMap: live-updating ASCII map plugin for Ancient Anguish (MUSHclient) -- =========================================================================== local FONT_ID = "oerthe_font" local FONT_NAME = "Courier New" local FONT_SIZE = 10 local MARGIN = 4 local MIN_VIEW = 3 local VIEW_W = 21 -- cells wide (must be odd so player is dead-center) local VIEW_H = 15 -- cells tall (must be odd) local HIGHLIGHT_BG = 0x004080 -- BGR: a muted blue highlight behind the player's cell local UNKNOWN_TEXT_COLOUR = 0x888888 local BG_COLOUR = 0x000000 -- Zoom is implemented by changing the grid font's point size (bigger glyphs -- = fewer cells fit = zoomed in), rather than sub-cell scaling -- this is an -- ASCII/glyph map, so "zoom" only really makes sense at font granularity. local ZOOM_SIZES = { 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 24 } local DEFAULT_ZOOM_INDEX = 5 -- ZOOM_SIZES[5] == 10, matches the original fixed FONT_SIZE local zoomIndex = DEFAULT_ZOOM_INDEX local CTRL_FONT_ID = "oerthe_ctrl_font" local CTRL_FONT_SIZE = 11 local CTRL_LINE_H_PX = 14 -- recalculated in InitWindow local CTRL_GAP = 4 local ZOOM_BTN_SIZE = 18 local SNAP_BTN_W, SNAP_BTN_H = 46, 18 local DEPTH_BTN_W = 58 -- wider than SNAP_BTN_W: "DEPTH" is a longer label than "SNAP" -- Keep the pan/zoom hotspot clear of winframe's own resize-edge strips -- (its EDGE_PX), so the window can still be resized from its edges. local PAN_EDGE_INSET = 6 -- Caps how often a pan drag actually repaints the grid (see -- winframe:throttled). Without this, zooming out shrinks CELL_W_PX/ -- LINE_H_PX, so the same mouse-drag distance crosses more map cells -- -- each crossing fires a repaint, and each repaint has more visible -- cells to draw, so panning while zoomed out was firing a burst of -- increasingly expensive full-grid repaints for one drag gesture. local PAN_REPAINT_INTERVAL = 1 / 30 -- placeholders, recalculated in InitWindow; SYMBOL_W_PX is the width of the -- 2-character glyph itself, CELL_W_PX is the column stride (symbol + a -- single-space gap before the next column, matching the in-game 'read map' -- layout). local CHAR_W_PX, LINE_H_PX, SYMBOL_W_PX, CELL_W_PX = 8, 14, 16, 24 -- Runtime state ------------------------------------------------------------- local player = { x = nil, y = nil } -- The map's current view center. While snapToLocation is true, the view -- always tracks the player (view.x/y are ignored); dragging the map with -- the mouse disengages snapToLocation and pans view.x/y independently. local view = { x = nil, y = nil } local snapToLocation = true local panDragState = nil -- Whether ocean/glacier cells are coloured by depth tier (see -- DEPTH_COLOURS below) instead of their flat legend colour. Off by -- default so a fresh install looks exactly like before this existed. local showDepth = false local seed_data = { legend = {}, cells = {}, titles = {}, depths = {} } local learned_data = { cells = {} } local cells = {} -- merged view: seed overridden by learned local legend = {} local titles = {} local depths = {} -- "x,y" -> 1..5, only for cells with known ocean depth local promptCapture = { active = false, lines = {} } local mapCapture = { active = false, lines = {} } local lastReadMapDebug = nil local coordLineSpecs = {} -- triggerName -> { pattern=, xGroup=, yGroup= } local currentCoordSpecs = nil -- last-installed specs list, so the hide/show toggle can re-install without resending "prompt settings" local readMapCommand = "read map" local hideCoordLine = false -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Small helpers -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function ClientNote(msg) ColourNote("orange", "", "[OertheMap] " .. msg) end local function DirOf(pluginId) local dir = GetPluginInfo(pluginId, 20) or "" if dir ~= "" and dir:sub(-1) ~= "/" and dir:sub(-1) ~= "\\" then dir = dir .. "/" end return dir end local function PluginDir() return DirOf(GetPluginID()) end -- winframe.lua (draggable/resizable window chrome) lives in the -- mush_windows plugin, not here, so every plugin with a window shares -- one copy instead of each bundling its own. Plugins can only find each -- other by an ID they both already know (not by searching), so this is -- MUSHclient's own sanctioned dependency pattern -- see -- mush_windows.xml's header comment, and nickgammon's checkplugin.lua, -- for the same shape of check. local WINDOWS_PLUGIN_ID = "26a4ca2758d503d86efe902e" local function EnsureWindowsPlugin() if IsPluginInstalled(WINDOWS_PLUGIN_ID) then if not GetPluginInfo(WINDOWS_PLUGIN_ID, 17) then EnablePlugin(WINDOWS_PLUGIN_ID, true) end if GetPluginInfo(WINDOWS_PLUGIN_ID, 17) then return true end ClientNote("the 'mush_windows' plugin is installed but could not be enabled -- " .. "enable it manually via File -> Plugins, then reload this plugin.") return false end -- Convenience for this dev workspace, where mush_windows lives in a -- sibling folder next to this plugin's own: try auto-installing it -- from there. A real end-user install won't necessarily have that -- layout, so this is wrapped defensively -- either way, IsPluginInstalled -- below is checked again rather than assumed to have worked. pcall(function() LoadPlugin(PluginDir() .. "../mush_windows/mush_windows.xml") end) if IsPluginInstalled(WINDOWS_PLUGIN_ID) then return true end ClientNote("requires the 'mush_windows' plugin (shared window chrome), which isn't installed. " .. "Install mush_windows.xml first (see its README.md), then reload this plugin.") return false end local function LoadLuaFile(path) local chunk, err = loadfile(path) if not chunk then return nil, err end local ok, result = pcall(chunk) if not ok then return nil, result end return result end local function HexToMushColour(hex) if not hex then return UNKNOWN_TEXT_COLOUR end local r = tonumber(hex:sub(2, 3), 16) or 0 local g = tonumber(hex:sub(4, 5), 16) or 0 local b = tonumber(hex:sub(6, 7), 16) or 0 return r + g * 256 + b * 65536 end -- Legend colours never change once loaded, but DrawGrid calls into this -- for every visible cell on every repaint -- with more cells visible -- when zoomed out, that's the hex string parsing above running -- thousands of times a second during a pan. Do it once per legend entry -- here instead, and have DrawGrid read the cached .rgb field. local function PrecomputeLegendColours(tbl) for _, info in pairs(tbl) do info.rgb = HexToMushColour(info.color) end end -- Depth-tier colours, shallow to deep, matching skrambelled/aa-map's own -- css/map.css (.depth1..depth5). Only ever applied to "=" (sea) glyphs -- -- see DrawGrid -- since that's the only symbol whose own legend colour -- the source site lets a per-cell depth colour override (other terrain, -- e.g. glaciers, keeps its own fixed colour there regardless of the -- depth value underneath it). local DEPTH_COLOUR_HEX = { "#2146ff", "#0052ce", "#0000b9", "#000086", "#00004a" } local DEPTH_COLOURS = {} for i, hex in ipairs(DEPTH_COLOUR_HEX) do DEPTH_COLOURS[i] = HexToMushColour(hex) end local function EscapeRegex(s) return (s:gsub("([%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?{}|\\])", "\\%1")) end -- The point the grid is drawn around: the player's position, unless the -- map has been panned away from it (snapToLocation false). local function CurrentCenter() if snapToLocation or not view.x then return player.x, player.y end return view.x, view.y end -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Data loading / merging / persistence -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function RebuildCells() cells = {} for k, v in pairs(seed_data.cells or {}) do cells[k] = v end for k, v in pairs(learned_data.cells or {}) do cells[k] = v end end local function LoadData() local dir = PluginDir() local seed, err = LoadLuaFile(dir .. "seed_data.lua") if seed then seed_data = seed else ClientNote("no seed_data.lua found (" .. tostring(err) .. ") -- run map_import_seed , or just use map_setup + explore to learn the map from scratch.") seed_data = { legend = {}, cells = {}, titles = {}, depths = {} } end legend = seed_data.legend or {} titles = seed_data.titles or {} depths = seed_data.depths or {} PrecomputeLegendColours(legend) local learned = LoadLuaFile(dir .. "learned_data.lua") learned_data = learned or { cells = {} } learned_data.cells = learned_data.cells or {} RebuildCells() end function SaveLearnedData() local path = PluginDir() .. "learned_data.lua" local f, err = io.open(path, "w") if not f then ClientNote("could not save learned_data.lua: " .. tostring(err)) return end f:write("-- Auto-updated by OertheMap from live 'read map' captures. Do not hand-edit.\n") f:write("return {\n cells = {\n") local keys = {} for k in pairs(learned_data.cells) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end table.sort(keys) for _, k in ipairs(keys) do f:write(string.format(" [%q] = %q,\n", k, learned_data.cells[k])) end f:write(" },\n}\n") f:close() end local function SaveCoordConfig(specs) local path = PluginDir() .. "coord_config.lua" local f, err = io.open(path, "w") if not f then ClientNote("could not save coord_config.lua: " .. tostring(err)) return end f:write("-- Auto-generated by map_setup from your 'prompt settings' output.\n") f:write("return {\n") for _, spec in ipairs(specs) do f:write(string.format( " { pattern = %q, xGroup = %s, yGroup = %s },\n", spec.pattern, spec.xGroup and tostring(spec.xGroup) or "nil", spec.yGroup and tostring(spec.yGroup) or "nil" )) end f:write("}\n") f:close() end local function InstallCoordTriggers(specs) -- Clear any previously installed coordinate triggers first. for name, _ in pairs(coordLineSpecs) do DeleteTrigger(name) end coordLineSpecs = {} currentCoordSpecs = specs -- flags: enabled(1) + regexp(32) + replace-if-exists(1024) = 1057, -- plus omit-from-output(4) when the coordinate line should be hidden. local flags = 1057 + (hideCoordLine and 4 or 0) for i, spec in ipairs(specs) do local name = "oerthe_coord_" .. i AddTriggerEx(name, spec.pattern, "", flags, -1, 0, "", "OnCoordLineMatch", 0, 100) coordLineSpecs[name] = spec end end function SetHideCoordLine(hide) hideCoordLine = hide SetVariable("hide_coord_line", hide and "1" or "0") if currentCoordSpecs then InstallCoordTriggers(currentCoordSpecs) end ClientNote(hide and "the coordinate line will now be hidden from your output." or "the coordinate line will now be shown again.") end local function LoadCoordConfig() local specs = LoadLuaFile(PluginDir() .. "coord_config.lua") if specs then InstallCoordTriggers(specs) return true end return false end -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Seed data import: parses a locally-saved copy of the static map page -- (https://anguish.org/gameplay/mapoerthe.html) into seed_data.lua. -- Pure Lua -- no external tools involved beyond however you saved the page. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local SEED_X_MIN, SEED_X_MAX = -47, 80 local function ParseLegendAndTitles(html) local legendTbl = {} for line in html:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do local hex, comment = line:match('%.C%d+%s*{color:%s*(#%x%x%x%x%x%x);}%s*/%*%s*(.-)%s*%*/') if hex then local symbol, desc = comment:match("^(%S+)%s+(.*)$") if symbol then for i = 1, #symbol do local ch = symbol:sub(i, i) if legendTbl[ch] and legendTbl[ch].desc ~= desc then legendTbl[ch] = { color = hex, desc = legendTbl[ch].desc .. " / " .. desc } else legendTbl[ch] = { color = hex, desc = desc } end end end end end local titlesTbl = {} for t in html:gmatch('title="([^"]*)"') do local x, y, tname = t:match("^%((%-?%d+),%s*(%-?%d+)%)%s+(.*)$") if x then titlesTbl[x .. "," .. y] = tname end end return legendTbl, titlesTbl end local function ParseSeedGrid(html) local cellsTbl = {} local rowCount = 0 local expectedLen = (SEED_X_MAX - SEED_X_MIN + 1) * 2 for line in html:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do local yStr, rest = line:match("^%s*(%-?%d+)|(.*)$") if yStr then local content = rest:match("^(.-)|%-?%d+%s*$") if content then local y = tonumber(yStr) local parts = {} for txt in content:gmatch(']*>([^<]*)') do parts[#parts + 1] = txt end local joined = table.concat(parts) if #joined == expectedLen then for col = 0, SEED_X_MAX - SEED_X_MIN do local x = SEED_X_MIN + col local sym = joined:sub(col * 2 + 1, col * 2 + 2) if sym ~= " " then cellsTbl[x .. "," .. y] = sym end end rowCount = rowCount + 1 end end end end return cellsTbl, rowCount end local function SortedKeys(t) local keys = {} for k in pairs(t) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end table.sort(keys) return keys end -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- New-format import: skrambelled/aa-map's static HTML export (html/map.html -- in that repo), a with one
-- per cell containing two {char}. Totally -- different shape from the old anguish.org page ParseLegendAndTitles/ -- ParseSeedGrid above target (row-based lines, numbered "C123" CSS classes, -- title="(x, y) name" attributes) -- MapImportSeed picks whichever parser -- matches by sniffing for this table's id. This format has NO title data of -- its own at all (see MapImportSeed's title-carry-forward for how named -- locations survive a re-import from it anyway), but DOES give per-cell -- ocean depth, which the old format never had. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Colour/description per CSS class name, hand-copied from that repo's -- css/map.css -- NOT derived from the saved HTML file itself, since a -- plain saved copy of the page won't necessarily carry its stylesheet -- along with it, and this handful of terrain colours essentially never -- changes. (.sea's colour there is deliberately commented out in that -- repo -- depth is what colours sea tiles on the real site -- so the -- flat colour below is only used here when the depth-toggle is off.) local NEW_FORMAT_LEGEND_BY_CLASS = { beach = { color = "#808000", desc = "deserts, beach" }, lforest = { color = "#008000", desc = "light forest" }, forest = { color = "#008000", desc = "forest" }, thicket = { color = "#008000", desc = "thicket, bushes" }, hill = { color = "#808000", desc = "hills" }, mountain = { color = "#808000", desc = "mountains" }, rocky = { color = "#800000", desc = "rocky desert" }, barren = { color = "#FF0000", desc = "barren, rugged" }, sea = { color = "#0000FF", desc = "sea, lake" }, swamp = { color = "#008080", desc = "swamp, marsh" }, village = { color = "#FF0000", desc = "fortified village" }, building = { color = "#800080", desc = "settlement / building" }, path = { color = "#800000", desc = "path, sign" }, river = { color = "#008080", desc = "stream, river" }, cave = { color = "#AAAAAA", desc = "dungeon, cave" }, open = { color = "#00FF00", desc = "open-air areas" }, grassland = { color = "#008000", desc = "grasslands" }, glacier = { color = "#00FFFF", desc = "icecap, glacier" }, bridge = { color = "#00FFFF", desc = "bridge, ford" }, harbour = { color = "#800000", desc = "harbor, pier" }, } local function IsNewFormatPage(html) return html:find("(.-)(.-)') do local x = classAttr:match("x(%-?%d+)") local y = classAttr:match("y(%-?%d+)") if x and y then local key = x .. "," .. y cellsTbl[key] = c1 .. c2 local depth = tonumber(classAttr:match("depth(%d+)")) if depth then depthsTbl[key] = depth end if NEW_FORMAT_LEGEND_BY_CLASS[class1] then legendTbl[c1] = NEW_FORMAT_LEGEND_BY_CLASS[class1] end if NEW_FORMAT_LEGEND_BY_CLASS[class2] then legendTbl[c2] = NEW_FORMAT_LEGEND_BY_CLASS[class2] end cellCount = cellCount + 1 end end return legendTbl, cellsTbl, depthsTbl, cellCount end function MapImportSeed(name, line, wildcards) local path = wildcards[1] local f, err = io.open(path, "r") if not f then ClientNote("could not open " .. path .. ": " .. tostring(err)) return end local html = f:read("*a") f:close() local legendTbl, cellsTbl, freshTitlesTbl, depthsTbl, rowCount if IsNewFormatPage(html) then legendTbl, cellsTbl, depthsTbl, rowCount = ParseNewFormatGrid(html) freshTitlesTbl = {} else legendTbl, freshTitlesTbl = ParseLegendAndTitles(html) cellsTbl, rowCount = ParseSeedGrid(html) depthsTbl = nil -- this format has none; keep whatever's already loaded, below end if rowCount == 0 then ClientNote("parsed 0 rows out of " .. path .. " -- is this really a saved map page? Aborting, not overwriting seed_data.lua.") return end -- Carry a title forward from the CURRENTLY loaded data only where the -- fresh parse didn't already give this coordinate a name (the old -- anguish.org format does; the new skrambelled/aa-map format never -- does) AND the terrain there hasn't changed since (comparing against -- 'cells', the live seed+learned merged view) -- a changed symbol -- means whatever used to be here likely moved or was replaced, so its -- old name shouldn't carry over to whatever's there now. local titlesTbl = {} for k, v in pairs(freshTitlesTbl) do titlesTbl[k] = v end local carriedTitles = 0 for k, v in pairs(titles) do if not titlesTbl[k] and cellsTbl[k] == cells[k] then titlesTbl[k] = v carriedTitles = carriedTitles + 1 end end depthsTbl = depthsTbl or seed_data.depths or {} local outPath = PluginDir() .. "seed_data.lua" local out, werr = io.open(outPath, "w") if not out then ClientNote("could not write seed_data.lua: " .. tostring(werr)) return end out:write("-- Generated by map_import_seed from " .. path .. "\n") out:write("return {\n legend = {\n") for _, ch in ipairs(SortedKeys(legendTbl)) do out:write(string.format(" [%q] = { color = %q, desc = %q },\n", ch, legendTbl[ch].color, legendTbl[ch].desc)) end out:write(" },\n cells = {\n") local cellKeys = SortedKeys(cellsTbl) for _, k in ipairs(cellKeys) do out:write(string.format(" [%q] = %q,\n", k, cellsTbl[k])) end out:write(" },\n depths = {\n") local depthKeys = SortedKeys(depthsTbl) for _, k in ipairs(depthKeys) do out:write(string.format(" [%q] = %d,\n", k, depthsTbl[k])) end out:write(" },\n titles = {\n") local titleKeys = SortedKeys(titlesTbl) for _, k in ipairs(titleKeys) do out:write(string.format(" [%q] = %q,\n", k, titlesTbl[k])) end out:write(" },\n}\n") out:close() seed_data = { legend = legendTbl, cells = cellsTbl, titles = titlesTbl, depths = depthsTbl } legend = legendTbl titles = titlesTbl depths = depthsTbl PrecomputeLegendColours(legend) RebuildCells() RedrawMap() ClientNote("imported seed data: " .. #SortedKeys(legendTbl) .. " legend chars, " .. rowCount .. " rows, " .. #cellKeys .. " cells, " .. #depthKeys .. " with known depth, " .. #titleKeys .. " named locations (" .. carriedTitles .. " carried forward from before).") end -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Prompt-format auto-detection ("prompt settings" -> regex) -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function StartPromptCapture() promptCapture.active = true promptCapture.lines = {} ResetPromptTimer() end function ResetPromptTimer() DeleteTimer("oerthe_prompt_done") -- flags: enabled(1) + one-shot(4) = 5 AddTimer("oerthe_prompt_done", 0, 0, 0.4, "", 5, "FinishPromptCapture") end -- Converts one line of the reconstructed |TOKEN| template into a regex. local function BuildLineRegex(line) local pattern = "^" local hasX, hasY = false, false local xGroup, yGroup = nil, nil local groupIdx = 0 local pos = 1 while true do local s, e, token = line:find("|([^|]-)|", pos) if not s then pattern = pattern .. EscapeRegex(line:sub(pos)) break end if s > pos then pattern = pattern .. EscapeRegex(line:sub(pos, s - 1)) end local ename = token:match("^([^%*]+)") ename = (ename or token):lower() if ename == "xcoord" then groupIdx = groupIdx + 1 xGroup = groupIdx hasX = true pattern = pattern .. "(-?\\d+)" elseif ename == "ycoord" then groupIdx = groupIdx + 1 yGroup = groupIdx hasY = true pattern = pattern .. "(-?\\d+)" elseif ename == "colour" or ename == "color" then -- zero-width: assumes the trigger matches against colour-stripped text elseif ename == "pipe" then pattern = pattern .. "\\|" elseif ename == "space" then pattern = pattern .. " " else pattern = pattern .. ".*?" end pos = e + 1 end pattern = pattern .. "$" return { pattern = pattern, hasX = hasX, hasY = hasY, xGroup = xGroup, yGroup = yGroup } end -- The MUD (or the client) hard-wraps long output at a fixed column width, -- which can split a |TOKEN| in half across two physical lines -- and it -- does this without dropping or adding any characters, so the fix is to -- rejoin everything into one continuous string before looking for -- |NEWLINE| tokens, rather than trusting physical line boundaries. local function SplitOnNewlineToken(text) local logicalLines = {} local pos = 1 while true do local s, e = text:find("|NEWLINE|", pos, true) if not s then logicalLines[#logicalLines + 1] = text:sub(pos) break end logicalLines[#logicalLines + 1] = text:sub(pos, s - 1) pos = e + 1 end return logicalLines end function FinishPromptCapture() promptCapture.active = false local lines = promptCapture.lines if #lines == 0 then ClientNote("got no template lines back from 'prompt settings' -- is a custom prompt active? " .. "(try 'prompt set |HP|:|SP|>|NEWLINE|X:[|XCOORD|]Y:[|YCOORD|]' first)") return end local fullText = table.concat(lines, "") local logicalLines = SplitOnNewlineToken(fullText) local specs = {} for _, line in ipairs(logicalLines) do local spec = BuildLineRegex(line) if spec.hasX or spec.hasY then specs[#specs + 1] = spec end end if #specs == 0 then ClientNote("your prompt template doesn't contain |XCOORD| / |YCOORD|. " .. "Add them with 'prompt set ...' and run map_setup again.") return end InstallCoordTriggers(specs) SaveCoordConfig(specs) ClientNote("position tracking configured from " .. #specs .. " prompt line(s). Move around to test it " .. "(map_debug will show the last thing it parsed).") end function OnCoordLineMatch(name, line, wildcards) local spec = coordLineSpecs[name] if not spec then return end -- The game resends the prompt (and so this trigger fires) after every -- command/round, not just after moving -- e.g. in combat, or just -- pressing enter. Only redraw when the position actually changed: a -- full redraw deletes and recreates every hotspot, and doing that while -- the mouse is sitting still over one (trying to trigger a tooltip) -- resets MUSHclient's hover timer before it ever fires, which is why -- tooltips could never appear even though click/drag still worked fine. local changed = false if spec.xGroup then local newX = tonumber(wildcards[spec.xGroup]) if newX ~= player.x then player.x = newX; changed = true end end if spec.yGroup then local newY = tonumber(wildcards[spec.yGroup]) if newY ~= player.y then player.y = newY; changed = true end end if changed then RedrawMap() end end -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Live "read map" capture -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function OnMapBorderLine() if not mapCapture.active then mapCapture.active = true mapCapture.lines = {} else mapCapture.active = false ParseReadMapBlock(mapCapture.lines) end end function ParseReadMapBlock(lines) if #lines == 0 then return end if not player.x or not player.y then ClientNote("read map: your position isn't known yet (run map_setup / check your prompt), skipping.") return end local rows = {} local playerRow, playerCol, gridWidth = nil, nil, nil for i, raw in ipairs(lines) do local inner = raw:match("^%|%s?(.-)%s?%|$") if not inner then ClientNote("read map: unexpected row format, aborting this block.") return end local bpos = inner:find("<", 1, true) if bpos then local prefix = inner:sub(1, bpos - 1) local _, colCount = prefix:gsub("%S+", "") playerRow = i playerCol = colCount end local normalized = inner:gsub("[<>]", " ") local tokens = {} for tok in normalized:gmatch("%S+") do tokens[#tokens + 1] = tok end if gridWidth and #tokens ~= gridWidth then ClientNote("read map: inconsistent row width, aborting this block.") return end gridWidth = #tokens rows[i] = tokens end if not playerRow then ClientNote("read map: couldn't find your '<..>' position marker, skipping.") return end local learnedCount = 0 for r, tokens in ipairs(rows) do for c, tok in ipairs(tokens) do local x = player.x + ((c - 1) - playerCol) local y = player.y - (r - playerRow) learned_data.cells[x .. "," .. y] = tok learnedCount = learnedCount + 1 end end lastReadMapDebug = { rows = rows, playerRow = playerRow, playerCol = playerCol, atX = player.x, atY = player.y } RebuildCells() SaveLearnedData() RedrawMap() ClientNote("learned " .. learnedCount .. " cells from read map at (" .. player.x .. "," .. player.y .. ").") end -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Line dispatch (buffers whichever capture is active) -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local BORDER_LINE_PATTERN = "^%+%-+%+$" function OnPluginLineReceived(text) if promptCapture.active then -- The header line itself also fires this callback; don't record it. if text ~= "Your prompt:" then table.insert(promptCapture.lines, text) ResetPromptTimer() end end -- Don't rely on whether this fires before or after the border trigger -- toggles mapCapture.active for the SAME line -- explicitly exclude -- border-shaped lines from the buffer either way. if mapCapture.active and not text:match(BORDER_LINE_PATTERN) then table.insert(mapCapture.lines, text) end return true end -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Miniwindow rendering (via winframe.lua: drag/resize/min/max/border chrome) -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local mapWin = nil -- the winframe instance, created in OnPluginInstall local function RecomputeViewFromContent(contentW, contentH) VIEW_W = math.max(1, math.floor((contentW - MARGIN * 2) / CELL_W_PX)) VIEW_H = math.max(1, math.floor((contentH - MARGIN * 2) / LINE_H_PX)) end -- Shared pixel geometry for the zoom/snap control cluster, top-right of the -- content area. Used by both DrawControls (paint) and OnMapHotspots (click -- targets), so the two can never drift apart. local function ControlLayout(contentW) local top = mapWin:contentTop() + MARGIN local btnB = top + ZOOM_BTN_SIZE local plusL = contentW - MARGIN - ZOOM_BTN_SIZE local plusR = plusL + ZOOM_BTN_SIZE local minusR = plusL - CTRL_GAP local minusL = minusR - ZOOM_BTN_SIZE local snapR = minusL - CTRL_GAP local snapL = snapR - SNAP_BTN_W local depthR = snapL - CTRL_GAP local depthL = depthR - DEPTH_BTN_W return { depth = { l = depthL, t = top, r = depthR, b = top + SNAP_BTN_H }, snap = { l = snapL, t = top, r = snapR, b = top + SNAP_BTN_H }, zoomOut = { l = minusL, t = top, r = minusR, b = btnB }, zoomIn = { l = plusL, t = top, r = plusR, b = btnB }, } end local function DrawCenteredText(text, rect, colour) local tw = WindowTextWidth(mapWin.win, CTRL_FONT_ID, text, false) or 0 local tx = rect.l + math.floor(((rect.r - "," .. y] if name then local px = MARGIN + col * CELL_W_PX local py = top + MARGIN + row * LINE_H_PX local hid = "oerthe_cell_tip_" .. col .. "_" .. row -- Shares the pan/zoom behaviour so hovering a named cell isn't a -- dead zone for dragging or scrolling -- only the tooltip differs.
